biggest_catch: The $500+ direct deposit must not only start within 90 days but continue for three consecutive months — and the offer window closes September 25, 2026, leaving only two days to open the account.
catches: Open a new CCU Florida Free Checking Plus account, mentioning promo code MK-CHECKING at opening or entering it in the online application.
Establish a direct deposit of $500 or more within 90 days of account opening AND continue a direct deposit of $500 or more into the account for three consecutive months.
Acceptable direct deposits: paycheck, pension, or government benefits (such as Social Security). Transfers from an account and person-to-person transfers (including Zelle) do not qualify.
Not available to current CCU Florida checking account holders, joint owners on a checking account, or anyone who closed a CCU Florida checking account within the past 24 months.
A share savings account with a one-time $5 membership fee is required at account opening.
Incentive payout posts by the 5th of the month following the 90 days after meeting the requirements — realistically a 6+ month wait for the $250.
Membership available in Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk, and Volusia counties of Florida.
The official page does not state tax reporting for this bonus.

steps: Open a new Free Checking Plus account by September 25, 2026 using promo code MK-CHECKING (mention it or enter it in the online application).
Pay the one-time $5 membership share fee and fund the account.
Set up direct deposit of $500+ (paycheck, pension, or government benefits — not bank transfers or Zelle) within 90 days.
Keep the $500+ direct deposit going for three consecutive months.
Wait for the $250 to post by the 5th of the month following 90 days after meeting the requirements.
If you miss the 9/25/2026 opening deadline, the offer is gone.
